def align(target, blocks):
    raw = target['coupon_features_raw']
    out = raw.copy()
    ref = np.vstack([z['ref_coupons'] for z in blocks])
    lab = np.concatenate([z['lab_id'] for z in blocks])
    strata = np.concatenate([z['stratum'] for z in blocks])
    feats = np.vstack([z['coupon_features_raw'] for z in blocks])
    print('panel', len(ref), end=' ')
    for k in np.unique(target['lab_id']):
        pan = ref[lab == k]
        mu = np.median(pan.mean(0))
        sd = np.median(pan.std(0))
        i = target['lab_id'] == k
        out[i] = (raw[i] - mu) / sd
        feats[lab == k] = (feats[lab == k] - mu) / sd
        print(k, np.round([mu, sd], 3), end='; ')
    (_, cell, count) = np.unique(np.c_[lab, strata], axis=0, return_inverse=True, return_counts=True)
    w = 1 / count[cell, None]
    fill = np.nansum(w * feats, axis=0) / np.sum(w * np.isfinite(feats), axis=0)
    print('fill', np.round(fill, 3))
    return np.where(np.isfinite(out), out, fill)

def _features(train, test):
    x = np.vstack((train['coupon_features_raw'], test['coupon_features_raw'])).astype(float)
    ref = np.vstack((train['ref_coupons'], test['ref_coupons']))
    lab = np.r_[train['lab_id'], test['lab_id']]
    stratum = np.r_[train['stratum'], test['stratum']]
    for group in np.unique(lab):
        mask = lab == group
        panel = ref[mask]
        center = np.median(panel.mean(axis=0))
        scale = np.median(panel.std(axis=0, ddof=0))
        x[mask] = (x[mask] - center) / scale
    (_, cell, count) = np.unique(np.column_stack((lab, stratum)), axis=0, return_inverse=True, return_counts=True)
    weight = 1.0 / count[cell].reshape(-1, 1)
    observed = np.isfinite(x)
    mean = np.nansum(weight * x, axis=0) / np.sum(weight * observed, axis=0)
    return np.where(observed, x, mean)

def _calibration(cal):
    raw = np.asarray(cal['bridge_raw'])
    loads = np.asarray(cal['true_channel_loads'])
    return np.linalg.lstsq(np.column_stack((np.ones(len(raw)), raw)), loads, rcond=None)[0]

def _design(taus, coupons, dt, times):
    (past, hold, drift) = coupons
    after = np.cumsum(dt[::-1])[::-1] - dt
    memory = past @ (-np.expm1(-dt[:, None] / taus) * np.exp(-after[:, None] / taus))
    gap = hold[:, None] - memory
    curve = np.concatenate((gap[:, None, :] * -np.expm1(-times[:, None] / taus), drift[:, None, :] * times[None, :, None]), axis=2)
    rate = np.column_stack((gap / taus, drift))
    return (curve, rate)

def solve_batch(dataset: dict) -> dict:
    (train, test) = (dataset['train'], dataset['test'])
    (dt, t) = (np.asarray(dataset['past_dt']), np.asarray(dataset['eval_times']))
    x = _features(train, test)
    n = len(train['lab_id'])
    bridge = _calibration(dataset['calibration_load_cells'])
    inputs = _coupon_inputs(train, x[:n], bridge)
    (taus, theta) = _fit(inputs, dt, t, train['strain_curves_obs'] - train['strain_0'][:, None], train['instant_rate_obs'])
    (_, hold, _) = _coupon_inputs(test, x[n:], bridge)
    (curve, rate) = _chamber(taus, theta, hold, x[n:], t)
    return {'estimated_taus': taus, 'hereditary_weights': theta, 'predicted_strain': test['strain_0'][:, None] + curve, 'initial_rate_pred': rate}
